text: The text contrasts the presentation of the good versus evil theme in J.R.R. Tolkien's 'The Lord of the Rings' and C.S. Lewis's 'The Chronicles of Narnia'. Both works share the primary theme of good versus evil. However, they differ in their approach: 'The Lord of the Rings' features a complex world with a clear distinction between forces of good and darkness, whereas 'The Chronicles of Narnia' blurs this line by introducing characters who waver between sides, offering a more nuanced view of morality.
